summary: Automatic redraw is the default like upstream: every window is driven by its frame demand (no OnRedraw / SetFrameLoop opt-in); the effect flush draws dirty test windows; real windows are drawn by their WM_PAINT frame requests with or without a present hook. Accessed-entity tracking (reads, updates, creations during a frame's element phases, plus rendered views) feeds the invalidation. Ticket 03/09 cross-file follow-ups wired.
changes: gpui/frameloop.go: drivesFrames removed (every window drives frames); trackedEntities replace renderedViews; recordEntityAccess/trackEntity; App.drawDirtyTestWindowsInFlush (R:app.rs:1800-1812); drawDirtyTestWindows limited to test windows; re-entrant frame request also skipped while a frame completes

gpui/app.go: flushEffects draws dirty test windows when the queue is quiet (and continues when the draws queued effects); App.Update no longer records rendered views; withEntityUpdate records entity access
gpui/entity.go: Read, Update (access) and NewEntity record entity access during a frame (R:app/entity_map.rs:120-160)
gpui/view.go: withRenderedView calls recordRenderedView after pushing the view

gpui/render.go: completeFrame — the frame-finish hook (finishFrame) is called explicitly from render.go (it swaps through endDispatchFrame), the window counts as drawing while finishing, then the frame is published clean and a focus move made by a focus listener refreshes the window afterwards (R:window.rs:3279-3285); entity access tracked only while drawRoots runs

gpui/element.go: retainElementStates returns the evicted states (no longer calls finishFrame); frameDrawState.trackingAccess; windowDrawState.finishing; unused windowOfDrawState removed; dropDrawState disposes a real window's text atlas (pre-existing slot leak exposed by repeated real-window runs: atlas status -2 after 8 windows)
gpui/helpers_frame.go, gpui/helpers_focus.go: finishFrame/dispatchFocusPhase report a focus move instead of requesting a refresh that the completing frame cleared
gpui/focus.go: requestRefresh is Window::refresh — markFrameDirty (wakes the frame source), no-op while drawing

gpui/window.go: frame state for every window; OnActivate always installed — OS activation reaches Window.activationChanged (active flag, ObserveWindowActivation observers, refresh) before the user hook (R:window.rs:1887-1902); OnRedraw/OnActivate docs
gpui/testapp.go: SetFrameLoop removed; RunUntilParked/AdvanceClock always serve frames
gpui/key_dispatch.go: ModifiersChanged updates the window's tracked modifiers (R:window.rs:5787-5790)
gpui/accessibility.go: canonicalElementID encodes NamedInteger/NamedChild/CodeLocation distinctly (R:window.rs:7655-7675); Name/View/Integer encodings unchanged
tests_added: TestRealWindowActivationReachesObservers (real window, SendMessage WM_ACTIVATE, no input simulation)

unchanged; exact animation frame count tolerates one extra frame per OS activation report (activation now refreshes, R:window.rs:1898)

the panicking build (now drawn by the mutation's flush) leaves draws/tree/selection at the prior frame; recovery republishes
each helper call draws exactly one frame (explicit draw only if the update's flush drew nothing); stateful switch applied in the drawing update
the fixture's hand-rolled flush-draw mirror removed: the port's own flush draw matches the recorded reference trace (fx-0006)
